source.kaggle_context: Kaggle v12 timed out and v13 was blocked by weekly GPU quota, so this run used the approved remote L20 GPU.

scope.purpose: Arabic-only MIRACL reranking diagnostic after all-subset MIRACL was too large for Kaggle.

interpretation: E5 completes the Arabic MIRACL reranking subset with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.774970.
The MIRACL Arabic subset is much heavier than Namaa reranking: E5 took about 44.95 minutes versus 17.4 seconds on Namaa.
This confirms E5 remains a viable broad reranking baseline on a harder Arabic retrieval-style benchmark, but it does not yet establish model-level SOTA.
Run BGE-M3 on the same Arabic-only MIRACL subset before drawing a stronger reranking-family conclusion.
next_experiment: Run MIRACLReranking eval_subsets=['ar'] for BAAI/bge-m3 on the remote L20 GPU, then compare against E5.
